أنتشر (form VIII)
# أَنْتَشِرُ (ʔantaširu) /ʔan.ta.ʃi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَشَرَ (intašara)
# أَنْتَشِرَ (ʔantašira) /ʔan.ta.ʃi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَشَرَ (intašara)
# أَنْتَشِرْ (ʔantašir) /ʔan.ta.ʃir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَشَرَ (intašara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
